The '''Xolochi Dreadnought''' was a [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]-class type of [[Warship/Legends|warship]] used by the [[Xim's empire|empire]] of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] despot [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] during it's [[Xim Wars|conflict]] with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. One also served as part of a task force to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Galuch]] at that time.

==Behind the scenes==
The Xolochi Dreadnought was designed by [[Ian Fullwood]]. He chose to give it a cigar-shaped hull specifically to draw out the reflection surface on the ship.<ref name="Designing Warships">{{InsiderCite|134|Designing Warships}}</ref>
